$comment: The campaign ledger. Empty on purpose, with the rules for filling it. Columns may only be populated from authorized first-party reports; a row with no provenance is rejected by tools/validate-data.mjs.

allowed_sources: Amazon Associates Central > Reports (link clicks, items added, ordered revenue, units)
Amazon Associates Central > Earnings report, exported
Search Console > Performance export (queries, pages, clicks, impressions, position)
The self-hosted event endpoint (page views, impressions, outbound clicks, gate blocks, signups)
forbidden: any number computed from an assumption and then quoted as measured
policy.null_semantics: null means not yet obtained. 0 means measured as zero. They are never interchangeable.
policy.attribution_window: Associates defines Qualifying Purchase and Session inside the Operating Agreement, and the timing windows quoted there (a session ending 24 hours after the click or on an order; the 89-day order window) come from the public Amazon.in copy of the agreement, which was readable from here. The US text has not been quoted into this ledger: re-read affiliate-program.amazon.com before printing either window to a reader (FLG-012).

columns.meaning: the day the row's numbers describe
which authorized report the numbers came from
tracking ID or traffic channel the row covers
units added to basket via your links
export filename or screenshot reference + who pulled it

derived_metrics.rule: click-through rate, conversion rate and EPC are computed from rows at render time and are printed only when every input is non-null. With zero rows they render as a dash, not a zero.
